_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py. Company figures are the company's own claims. Distances from two companies are never reconciled, averaged or differenced.

aurora_trucks_year_end.basis: Aurora's allocation to exit 2026, not trucks now running

aurora_trucks_now_reported.basis: Breitbart, citing a CNBC ride. Secondary

permian_trucks.basis: Kodiak's own figure, end of second quarter

acknowledgements.basis: count of the numbered list the applicant acknowledges, one claim per item

soah.rounding: sum of the three windows, the longest a review can run before the hearing must be held

days_enforceable_to_run.basis: May 28th, 2026 to the run date September 26th, 2026

days_rules_to_enforceable.basis: the gap the department describes as 90 days after the rules

geometry._note: metres for the renderer, never printed
